title: Fed-Health: Federated Learning & Causal Analysis on Diabetes Readmission
summary: A healthcare research pipeline combining federated learning across simulated hospitals, causal inference, GAN-based data augmentation, and active learning to predict diabetic patient readmission. The gan_module trains a standalone CTGAN model on hospital data to synthesize samples that improve rare-class recall, directly importing and running the CTGAN package from the SDV family.
